metric.external_integration_coverage.limitations: Domain list is a fixed, declared sample of common production-integration needs, not exhaustive; it does not capture integration depth/feature-completeness beyond an official-vs-community-vs-absent tier, and several domains rely on stable, well-established facts not independently re-searched this pass to conserve the shared query budget across the two assigned metrics.
metric.external_integration_coverage.selection_rule: Evaluate working documented integrations and binding ecosystems, not only theoretical FFI design; FFI language design itself belongs to Language Quality.

metric.implemented_platform_coverage.limitations: Binary per-category scoring does not capture depth/quality differences within a supported platform (e.g. tier-1 CI-tested vs best-effort community support); this is a coarse breadth proxy, not a quality proxy. metric.implemented_platform_coverage.selection_rule: Count only platforms with currently implemented and documented build/run support; design intent without working support does not count.
